text: Mahershalalhashbaz: Heb. In making speed to the spoil he hasteneth the prey. Or, make speed, etc
the riches of Damascus, and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of Assyria: Or, He that is before the King of Assyria shall take away the riches etc.
the stretching out of his wings shall fill the breadth of thy land: Heb. the fullness of the breadth of thy land shall be the stretching out of his wings
with a strong hand: Heb. in strength of hand
